description: This source file implements the CrosvmManager class for managing virtual machines using crosvm in the Cuttlefish project. It includes configuration, startup, and support checking functionalities, as well as handling GPU and device passthrough configurations.

classes.name: CrosvmManager
classes.description: Manager class for handling VM lifecycle and configuration using crosvm in the Cuttlefish environment.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current host environment supports running crosvm, based on platform capabilities.

methods.name: ConfigureGraphics
methods.description: Configures graphics-related boot parameters based on the GPU mode specified in the instance configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureBootDevices
methods.description: Determines and configures the boot devices for the VM based on the instance configuration and architecture.

methods.name: ToSingleLineString
methods.description: Converts a JSON value to a compact single-line string.

methods.name: HostSwiftShaderIcdPathForArch
methods.description: Returns the path to the SwiftShader ICD JSON file based on host architecture.

methods.name: HostLavapipeIcdPathForArch
methods.description: Returns the path to the Lavapipe ICD JSON file based on host architecture.

methods.name: MaybeConfigureVulkanIcd
methods.description: Sets environment variables for Vulkan ICD files based on GPU mode.

methods.name: MaybeConfigureMemOverridesLibrary
methods.description: Configures environment for memory override library to work around specific hardware issues.

methods.name: CrosvmPathForVhostUserGpu
methods.description: Returns the path to the crosvm binary suitable for vhost-user GPU configuration based on host architecture.

methods.name: BuildVhostUserGpu
methods.description: Builds and configures the vhost-user GPU device command and related processes.

methods.name: ConfigureGpu
methods.description: Configures GPU parameters for the crosvm command based on the GPU mode.

methods.name: StartCommands
methods.description: Generates the list of commands to start the crosvm VM, including all device and logging configurations.

methods.name: WaitForRestoreComplete
methods.description: Waits for the VM restore process to complete and resumes the VM.
